WITH per_reference AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    execution_count,
    1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM per_reference
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    execution_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - AVG(share) OVER () DESC) AS difference_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, difference
FROM ranked
WHERE difference_rank <= 10
ORDER BY difference_rank ASC, ordersmark ASC;

assumptions.assumption: All executions with a NULL ordersmark form one group, as specified. The average share is the unweighted arithmetic mean across the resulting order-reference groups.
